description: DR-152 / IR-024 T06: frozen actual pre-design schema-5 history; synthetic local tests only

schema.name: assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE assets (
        ontology_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, domain TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: build_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE build_requests (
                    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
                    run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(run_id))

schema.name: legacy_assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE legacy_assets (
        legacy_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES versions(version_id), fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: run_artifacts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE run_artifacts (
        artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id),
        name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(run_id,name))

schema.name: run_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE run_events (
        run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq > 0),
        kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(run_id,seq))

schema.name: runs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
        run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(version_id), operation TEXT NOT NULL,
        task TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL, session_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
        components TEXT NOT NULL, ontology_snapshot TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','completed','failed','interrupted')),
        result TEXT, retry_of TEXT REFERENCES runs(run_id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, build_input TEXT, output_asset_ref TEXT, 
        CHECK ((build_input IS NULL AND ontology_id IS NOT NULL AND version_id IS NOT NULL
                AND ontology_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND output_asset_ref IS NULL)
            OR (build_input IS NOT NULL AND operation='build_ontology' AND mode='real'
                AND ontology_id IS NULL AND version_id IS NULL AND ontology_snapshot IS NULL)))

schema.name: sources
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
        source_asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, role TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: versions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE versions (
        version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        parent_version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(version_id), payload_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        source_asset_ids TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT NOT NULL,
        publication_state TEXT NOT NULL, publication_mode TEXT, validation TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: queued_builds
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX queued_builds ON runs(operation,status)

schema.name: runs_by_session
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX runs_by_session ON runs(session_ref)

schema.name: versions_by_asset
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX versions_by_asset ON versions(ontology_id)

schema.name: governance_heads
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE governance_heads (
        ontology_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES versions(version_id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1))

schema.name: governance_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE governance_events (
        event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(version_id), record TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: governance_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE governance_requests (
        ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id), request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(ontology_id,request_id))

schema.name: governance_reviews
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE governance_reviews (
        review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES versions(version_id), record TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: version_artifacts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE version_artifacts (
        artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES versions(version_id), kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        record TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(version_id,kind))

schema.name: evidence_revocations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence_revocations (
        revocation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ontology_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(ontology_id),
        version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES versions(version_id), evidence_iri TEXT NOT NULL,
        record TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: governance_events_by_asset
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX governance_events_by_asset ON governance_events(ontology_id)

schema.name: evidence_revocations_by_asset
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX evidence_revocations_by_asset ON evidence_revocations(ontology_id)

schema.name: robotics_task_sessions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE robotics_task_sessions (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, record TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: robotics_task_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE robotics_task_requests (
        scope TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, response TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(scope,request_id))
